definition: An open standard for connecting AI applications to external tools, data sources, and systems in a consistent, interoperable way.
details: MCP defines a common protocol so that different AI applications and different tool/data providers can interoperate, reducing the need for bespoke integrations between every model and every external system.
story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. The machine stops just answering one question and starts getting a job done, step by step, checking its work along the way. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Model Context Protocol.
